advisory.text:
"Air Quality Advisory: For the Delhi/Karachi region (NW India + Pakistan), our estimates, not measurements, indicate higher uncertainty due to limited satellite coverage. Approximately 4.9 million people are exposed to Unhealthy air quality, while 37.3 million face Moderate levels. The northern-western and eastern parts of the region are most affected with air pollutant concentrations of ~54 µg/m³ and ~53 µg/m³ respectively. 

People with respiratory conditions, such as asthma or COPD, are at a higher risk from these unhealthy air quality levels. To mitigate exposure, consider indoor activities during daylight hours when outdoor pollution is typically lower. If possible, use high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters in your homes and consider wearing masks, especially for those outside. Remember, our estimates, not measurements, highlight areas with higher concern but don't reflect the actual situation everywhere."
